capabilities: Catalog budget items in a reusable catalog note
Build budget notes by picking items from the catalog
Log spending and record credits against budget items
Filter and sort budget and catalog tables by field and spending status
Choose colour-blindness palettes for priority and balance colours
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; the README instructs installing via BRAT (housni/earmark) or manually copying release files, and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. YAML edits by hand are supported but # comments inside the block are lost on save; unparseable YAML is left untouched with an error shown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a reusable catalog of budget items and track spending, credits and balances against them inside notes.

relations.evidence: Until Earmark is in the community plugin store, install it with BRAT

summary: Budget manager that catalogs budget items and builds budgets from them, tracking spending, credits and balances as YAML in note code blocks.
